tasks.check: for m in MARKERS_DONE DIFF_DONE REPRO_DONE; do grep -q "$m" triage.txt || { echo "FAIL: missing marker $m"; tail -5 triage.txt; exit 1; }; done; grep -qE 'STORED_VS_SENT_DIFFS=[0-9]+' triage.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no stored-vs-sent diff count'; exit 1; }; test "$(grep -c 'REPRO v' triage.txt)" -ge 6 || { echo 'FAIL: fewer than 6 chat repro lines'; grep -c 'REPRO v' triage.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'CREATE_FAIL' triage.txt && { echo 'FAIL: at least one chat create failed'; grep CREATE_FAIL triage.txt; exit 1; }; echo "MEASURED: $(grep -m1 'STORED_VS_SENT_DIFFS=' triage.txt); $(grep 'after_hi_node' triage.txt | head -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
tasks.verified: Discriminating evidence for the all-red v124 battery: start-node markers of stored v123 vs v124 side by side, a node-level proof of whether Bland stored exactly the draft we minted, and six live chat repros (three per version, created exactly like the battery harness with no explicit start node) showing which node each version actually starts on.
